source_context: Actual selected source body/wheels, source28/29,r002, full guideway/stations/receivers, original D09 floor and five public-core enclosures. Two independent static review poses; travel evidence separate.
observations: End view shows complete original car, the physical terminal buffer, retained station stair/support context and all four original wheels.
Corner view shows complete car at the tested maximum steering curve, with the retained rail bend, receiving frame and original floor below.
Small underfloor fittings remain partly occluded by the immutable car floor in normal external views; native46-mesh and engine steering/contact evidence is separate.
Review ambient/sun and software OpenGL are disclosed; not ordinary calibrated lighting/CRT/hardware acceptance.
capture_environment_warning: X11 driver cannot change VSync; no engine/script errors in accepted captures. Not target GPU performance evidence.
